exitRule.sixes: Only leave yard on double sixes (6+6)
exitRule.six: Leave yard on a six on either die

rules.1: Roll two dice. The dice are summed to move a single pawn.
rules.2: Pawns leave the yard based on the rule chosen by the host.
rules.3: Doubles, capturing an opponent, or reaching home grants an extra roll.
rules.4: Start squares and star squares are safe zones.
rules.5: Three consecutive doubles forfeits your turn.
rules.6: Reach the exact final square or bounce back if the roll overshoots without doubles.
